summary: 23 photo, 9 unsure, 68 skip checked. photo: 0 wrong keeps; 23 worth keeping (Williams Tower and ExxonMobil Building are the weakest, justified only by postmodern/Philip Johnson and the fins/1963 record); 2 field fixes (Military Cathedral year 1994, Akita concept); 6 main-photo flags (2 with a better file: Shimane, ExxonMobil; 4 borderline with none: Samuel Freeman, Kraus, Zlota 44, Kalita Humphreys); all names, by, city, cc, year, coords, commons and photo licences match prep.json, all types/movements/concepts are in vocab.json, no feature sentence has an invented fact. unsure: 3 resolved with a usable main photo (Auldbrass, The Concourse, Pruitt-Igoe, the last needing an owner call as it is demolished), 3 keep=true but still no photo (University of Brasilia, La Marseillaise, Kundert), 3 keep=false (Saarinen Tribune design, Aurora Plaza, WTC Tokyo). skips: 11 strong wrong skips (Taichung Library, Saint-Denis Pleyel, Fukui Dinosaur Museum, Torre Realia BCN, Kreeger Museum, Saka no Ue no Kumo, Onomichi, Walker House, Kubitschek Residence, Reinhard Ernst, Mellon Hall) plus 10 moderate or low; the remaining 47 skips are right (metro stations, ordinary towers, collection-only museums, no photos). Pattern: Haiku skipped when the lead was short even though prep.architect named a famous architect, while keeping equally short Wright leads.
